children: Overview
China port operator's interim revenue rose 10.8% yr/yr, driven by container and logistics growth
Net profit attributable to shareholders fell 2.8% yr/yr, mainly due to lower non-recurring gains
Company declared interim dividend equal to about 33% of net profit attributable to shareholders
Outlook
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for the current quarter or full year
Result Drivers
CONTAINER BUSINESS - Co said revenue growth was mainly driven by increased container handling volume and optimization of commercial policies
LOGISTICS GROWTH - Co said logistics and port value-added services revenue rose due to increased logistics business benefiting from higher container volumes
NON-RECURRING GAINS - Co said net profit attributable to shareholders fell mainly due to lower non-recurring gains compared to prior year

Analyst Coverage
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "hold"
The average consensus recommendation for the marine port services peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Qingdao Port International Co Ltd is HK$7.50, about 7.1% above its August 27 closing price of HK$7.00
The stock recently traded at 7 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 8 three months ago
